about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a software developer and have freelanced on Fiverr since 2024, building web apps and dashboards for clients and teaching Python, SQL and JavaScript. While I finish my Software and Data Engineering degree at IU Digital, I'm specializing in backend and data engineering, and I also enjoy frontend work with React.

experience.title: Experience
experience.text: Freelancer on Fiverr since September 2024: web apps and dashboards with React and Node.js, and Python, SQL and JavaScript tutoring.

focus.title: Focus areas
focus.text: Backend · Data engineering · Databases · Frontend with React

terrall.title: Terrall
terrall.description: Interactive 3D map of Colombia: pick a department and see its data in a side panel, with real tourism data from the National Tourism Registry and its own REST API.
terrall.problem: Territorial information about Colombia is scattered across many sources and hard to explore by region.
terrall.role: Personal project: design, React and Three.js frontend, REST API with NestJS and PostgreSQL (with tests and continuous integration, deployed on Render) and open-data ingestion.

wanderbricks.title: Wanderbricks Lakehouse
wanderbricks.description: Medallion lakehouse (bronze, silver and gold) on Databricks, with Unity Catalog governance, an automated Job and a join-optimization analysis.
wanderbricks.problem: Marketing needs to know which devices and channels end in confirmed, paid bookings.
wanderbricks.role: Bronze layer, Delta Lake guarantees, lineage, two-task Job and the optimization baseline, in a team of three.

talentcorp.title: TalentCorp HR Data Warehouse
talentcorp.description: Operational database, ETL with stored procedures and a star-schema data warehouse with 15 HR KPIs and 15 data-quality checks.
talentcorp.problem: A company with offices in several countries needed reliable HR metrics from its operational database.
talentcorp.role: Solo project: modeling, ETL with SCD Type 2, security (Dynamic Data Masking and Row-Level Security) and analytical queries.

mongodb.title: Academic system in MongoDB
mongodb.description: Academic management with JSON Schema validation, CRUD, four multi-document transactions with rollback and five aggregation-pipeline reports.
mongodb.problem: Record enrollments, grades and graduations without leaving inconsistent data across collections.
mongodb.role: Solo project: document modeling, validations, transactions and reports.

localrent.title: LocalRent
localrent.description: Console app to manage properties, leases and payments, with overdue detection, Singleton and Factory Method patterns and Stream-based queries.
localrent.problem: Manage rentals of shops and apartments and detect overdue leases.
localrent.role: Solo project: object-oriented design, 25 JUnit 5 tests and continuous integration.

gimnasio.title: Multivariate analysis
gimnasio.description: Exploratory analysis, correlations and PCA on 961 gym members and 16 variables; four components retain 64.3% of the variance.
gimnasio.problem: Understand which physical and training variables are related and whether they can be summarized in a few dimensions.
gimnasio.role: Solo project: data cleaning, descriptive statistics, visualizations and PCA interpretation.

philosophy.title: My philosophy
philosophy.text: I believe in smooth processes, in the power of simplicity, and that technology can also be poetry. Every line of code is an opportunity to create something meaningful and elegant.
